meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode. Cuts output tokens 65% (measured) by speaking like caveman while keeping full technical accuracy. Supports intensity levels: lite, full (default), ultra, wenyan-lite, wenyan-full, wenyan-ultra. Use when user says "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "use caveman", "less tokens", "be brief", or invokes /caveman. Also auto-triggers when token efficiency is requested.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用原始人语气压缩 AI 回复,最高省 65% 输出量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望 AI 回复更简短、更省 token
copy.tagline_en: Speak caveman to slash token output by up to 65%.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want terse AI responses and lower token usage.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会改用极简“穴居人”式语言回答：去掉客套话、修饰词，只保留技术要点，实测可减少约65%的输出token。默认持续生效，直到你说“stop caveman”或“normal mode”。可用命令切换不同强度级别。
howto.when: 当你说“caveman mode”、“talk like caveman”等关键词，或调用 /caveman 命令，或要求节省token（如“less tokens”）时触发。

say.note: 要求简短，自动进入压缩模式。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude replies in ultra-terse caveman style: strips filler, keeps technical detail, cuts ~65% tokens (measured). Stays active until 'stop caveman' or 'normal mode'. Levels: lite, full, ultra, wenyan-*.
howto.when_en: Triggered by 'caveman mode', 'talk like caveman', etc., or /caveman command. Auto-triggers on token-efficiency requests.
